answer: Neighborhood persistence scoring. Each agent's trust weight is the delta between its current and prior neighbor-set overlap across epochs. A clone cluster yields high internal overlap but near-zero external delta, so its messages carry little routing weight. Fresh identities must sustain organic links across at least three epochs before gaining reach, and their traffic sits in a quarantine vault until then. Attackers pay in sustained link-maintenance across many real peers per identity. A pigment of shared history marks each node, making cheap mass registration ineffective.
